label: D2 after choosing a1 and landing in S2 (rare a1->S2 transition), late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, and essentially only when the agent chose a1 and the shown state is S2 (a rare a1->S2 transition): 99.9% of activation mass, and it never fires on a2->S2, S1, D1 or GO. The agent observes all of these at D2. It is silent before about episode trial 50, and its firing rate climbs through trials 50-99. Within late a1->S2 steps it fires on about 40% of cases. Those cases line up with a lower model value (<7.13); adding that condition raises dev F1 from 0.56 to 0.69 while keeping mass recall at 0.99. Activations are larger when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0 gets 70% of mass from 56% of actives) and in S1-good blocks. It does not fire on common transitions. The predicate uses only observed variables plus the model own value output.
